title: Mc retro
description: Mc retro is a windows 95 and simplistic mod. It turns most of the guis in the game into windows 95 windows!
body: Mc retro is a windows 95 and simplistic mod. It turns most of the guis in the game into windows 95 windows! I also made changed the textures of mobs so they look simpler and more retro. Redstone has been made blue like windows 95 along with the enderman switching to windows 95 colors aswell.
